_README: Historical photographs, grouped by season. Every season in history.json has a key here, including the empty ones — an empty array is what makes the site render a labelled 'no photos yet' slot, which is deliberate. `file` is relative to public/images/history/. To add photos: drop them in public/images/history/<year>/ (or list them in scripts/curated-photos.tsv and run scripts/import-history-photos.sh) and add an entry here. Captions must not name individuals. Full instructions: docs/HISTORY_AND_GALLERY.md
